methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected directly from each vendor's official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14. Auth0 annual billing is 11× monthly (≈8.33% discount; 1 month free). Clerk Pro annual rate is $20/mo vs $25/mo monthly (20% discount). Descope requires annual billing for Pro/Growth; no month-to-month rate published. WorkOS AuthKit is usage-based (per-MAU above 1M free); SSO/Directory Sync priced per connection per month; no flat monthly floor published for AuthKit alone. Stytch Pay As You Go has no base fee; charges are per-MAU above 10,000 free; monthlyUsd=0 reflects base cost of the smallest committed tier with usage metered above the free threshold. Amazon Cognito is pure pay-as-you-go per MAU; monthlyUsd=null for all plans as there is no flat floor (tier selection is per-account configuration, not a plan upgrade). Firebase Auth Blaze plan: no flat fee — charges only apply beyond the 50K MAU free threshold via Google Cloud Identity Platform metered rates; monthlyUsd=null. Supabase is included because Auth is a first-class feature with explicit MAU limits per plan. Okta Customer Identity Enterprise Base Platform lists a published $3,000/mo base; Workforce Identity per-seat prices are annual-only. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null — this is a non-telephony vertical.

vendors.name: Auth0
vendors.provenance: https://auth0.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14. HIPAA/BAA listed as Enterprise add-on ('Contact us'). Annual billing = 11× monthly (≈8.33% discount). B2C and B2B plans each start at 500 MAUs.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 25,000 MAUs. 1 custom domain, passwordless auth, unlimited social connections, 5 organizations, basic attack protection, 1 enterprise connection, self-service SSO, SCIM, community support.

plans.name: B2C Essentials
plans.notes: Starts at $35/mo for 500 MAUs (month-to-month). Annual: $385/yr ($32.08/mo equivalent). Adds pro MFA, RBAC, 10 organizations, audit log streaming, separate environments, standard support. Scales with MAU volume.

plans.name: B2C Professional
plans.notes: Starts at $240/mo for 500 MAUs (month-to-month). Annual: $2,640/yr ($220/mo equivalent). Adds enhanced attack protection, custom database connections, enterprise MFA, cross-app SSO.

plans.name: B2B Essentials
plans.notes: Starts at $150/mo for 500 MAUs (month-to-month). Annual: $1,650/yr ($137.50/mo equivalent). Includes unlimited organizations, 3 enterprise SSO connections, pro MFA, standard support. Additional SSO connections: $100/mo each.

plans.name: B2B Professional
plans.notes: Starts at $800/mo for 500 MAUs (month-to-month). Annual: $8,800/yr ($733.33/mo equivalent). Adds enhanced attack protection, enterprise MFA included, security center, custom token exchange. 5 SSO connections included.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. 99.99% SLA, custom user tiers, enterprise rate limits, advanced support, HIPAA/BAA add-on available.

vendors.name: Clerk
vendors.provenance: https://clerk.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14. HIPAA BAA explicitly listed as available on Enterprise plan. Pro annual rate $20/mo vs $25/mo monthly = 20% discount.

plans.name: Hobby
plans.notes: Free forever. Up to 50,000 MRUs (monthly recurring users) per app. No credit card required.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Month-to-month: $25/mo. Annual: $20/mo. 50,000 MRUs included per app; additional MRUs at $0.02/MRU/mo. Adds MFA, custom branding removal, enterprise connections.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Month-to-month: $300/mo. Annual: $250/mo. 50,000 MRUs included per app; additional MRUs at volume pricing ($0.012–$0.02/MRU/mo). 10 dashboard seats included; additional seats $20/mo each.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Annual billing only. Custom MAU limits, 99.99% uptime SLA, dedicated support, HIPAA compliance with BAA.

vendors.name: WorkOS
vendors.provenance: https://workos.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14. HIPAA/BAA not mentioned on pricing page. AuthKit (user management) is free up to 1M MAUs; $2,500/mo per additional 1M MAUs. SSO and Directory Sync priced per connection/month with volume tiers. No hipaa/baa confirmed from available pages.

plans.name: AuthKit — Free Tier
plans.notes: First 1M MAUs free. Includes email/password, social login, passkeys, MFA, magic auth, enterprise SSO. Usage-based above 1M MAUs: $2,500/mo per additional 1M MAUs.

plans.name: SSO / Directory Sync — Pay as You Go
plans.notes: Per-connection pricing: 1–15 connections at $125/connection/mo; 16–30 at $100/connection/mo (20% off); 31–50 at $80/connection/mo; 51–100 at $65/connection/mo; 101–200 at $50/connection/mo; 201+ contact sales. monthlyUsd reflects cost of a single connection at the lowest tier. Audit log streaming: $125/mo per SIEM connection; Event retention: $99/mo per 1M events.

plans.name: Annual Credits
plans.notes: Custom annual pricing with pre-pay discounts. Includes 99.99% uptime SLA, guided migration, guaranteed support SLA. Contact sales.

vendors.name: Stytch
vendors.provenance: https://stytch.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14. HIPAA/BAA explicitly listed as available on Enterprise plan. Pay As You Go plan has no base fee; 10,000 MAUs free, then usage-metered. monthlyUsd=0 reflects the base cost; overages are per-MAU.

plans.name: Pay As You Go
plans.notes: No base fee. 10,000 MAUs free, 5 SSO/SCIM connections, 1,000 M2M tokens, 10,000 fraud fingerprints included. Additional SSO/SCIM connections: $125/connection/mo. Brand customization: $99/mo. No feature gating — all authentication methods available. HIPAA/BAA only on Enterprise.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Unlimited organizations and connections, discounted rates, dedicated Slack support, migration assistance, 99.99% uptime SLA, HIPAA/BAA available, advanced fraud protection.

vendors.name: Firebase Authentication
vendors.provenance: https://firebase.google.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14. Firebase Auth is part of Firebase platform. Spark plan is fully free up to 50K MAUs. Blaze (pay-as-you-go) charges only above 50K MAUs at Google Cloud Identity Platform metered rates. HIPAA eligibility not listed on Firebase pricing page; Firebase BAA is available through Google Cloud but not confirmed on this page. No flat monthly tier exists for auth specifically.

plans.name: Spark (No-Cost)
plans.notes: Free forever. Up to 50,000 MAUs for standard auth; up to 50 MAUs for SAML/OIDC. No phone authentication available on Spark plan. Cannot exceed limits — upgrade to Blaze required.

plans.name: Blaze (Pay-as-You-Go)
plans.notes: No flat monthly fee for auth. First 50K MAUs free (matching Spark). Overage MAUs billed at Google Cloud Identity Platform rates. SAML/OIDC: 50 MAUs free then metered via Google Cloud. Phone auth billed per SMS sent at Google Cloud rates. No published flat rate — all usage is metered.

vendors.name: Okta
vendors.provenance: https://www.okta.com/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14. Workforce Identity per-seat prices are annual-only. Customer Identity (CIAM) Enterprise Base Platform lists $3,000/mo as a published starting price (billed annually). HIPAA listed on Okta Trust Center (https://security.okta.com/). B2C and B2B CIAM suites are quote-only beyond the base platform fee. Free developer plan available for CIAM (up to 10 MAU, non-production only).

plans.name: Workforce Identity — Starter
plans.notes: Billed annually at $6/user/mo. Minimum $1,500/yr contract. Includes SSO, MFA, Universal Directory, 5 Workflows. Month-to-month not publicly available.

plans.name: Workforce Identity — Core Essentials
plans.notes: Billed annually at $14/user/mo. Adds Adaptive MFA, Privileged Access, Lifecycle Management, 5 Workflows.

plans.name: Workforce Identity — Essentials
plans.notes: Billed annually at $17/user/mo. Most popular tier. Everything in Core Essentials plus 50 Workflows.

plans.name: Workforce Identity — Professional
plans.notes: Contact sales. Adds Device Access, ISPM, Threat Protection, unlimited Workflows.

plans.name: Workforce Identity — Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Adds API Access Management, Access Gateway, all Professional features.

plans.name: Customer Identity — Developer (Free)
plans.notes: Free developer plan. Up to 10 MAUs, non-production use only. No SLA.

plans.name: Customer Identity — Enterprise Base Platform
plans.notes: Billed annually at $3,000/mo. Foundation for all non-employee (CIAM) identities. B2C Suite and B2B Suite add-ons are quote-only on top of this base. MAU-based usage pricing applies for add-ons.

vendors.name: Amazon Cognito
vendors.provenance: https://aws.amazon.com/cognito/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14. Amazon Cognito is listed as HIPAA-eligible on https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/hipaa-eligible-services-reference/ (accessed 2026-06-14); BAA available via AWS Artifact. Three tiers (Lite/Essentials/Plus) are account-level configurations, not plan upgrades in the traditional sense — no flat monthly fee; all billing is per-MAU. monthlyUsd=null for all tiers as there is no flat monthly commitment.

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: 10,000 MAUs free/mo. Above free tier: $0.0055/MAU for first 90,000 MAUs, then $0.0046/MAU. SAML/OIDC federation: 50 MAUs free, then $0.015/MAU. No flat monthly fee.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: 10,000 MAUs free/mo. Above free tier: $0.015/MAU. SAML/OIDC: 50 MAUs free, then $0.015/MAU. Multi-Region replication add-on: $0.0045/MAU. No flat monthly fee.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: No free tier. $0.020/MAU from first MAU. SAML/OIDC: 50 MAUs free, then $0.015/MAU. M2M authorization: $0.00225–$0.002925 per token request. No flat monthly fee.

vendors.name: Supabase
vendors.provenance: https://supabase.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14. HIPAA available as a paid add-on on Team and Enterprise plans (not on Free or Pro). Auth MAU limits are per-plan: Free=50K, Pro=100K included, Team=100K included. Overage on Pro/Team: $0.00325/MAU.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 50,000 MAUs for auth. Unlimited total users. 2 active projects; project pauses after 1 week of inactivity. Community support. No HIPAA.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 100,000 MAUs included; additional MAUs at $0.00325/MAU. Includes $10/mo compute credit. Daily backups (7 days). Email support. No HIPAA on Pro plan.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: 100,000 MAUs included; additional MAUs at $0.00325/MAU. Priority email support with SLAs. Daily backups (14 days). HIPAA available as paid add-on. SOC2 and ISO 27001 compliance.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Custom MAU limits, 24×7×365 premium enterprise support, dedicated support manager, uptime SLAs, custom security features, BYO Cloud. HIPAA available as add-on.

vendors.name: Descope
vendors.provenance: https://www.descope.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14. HIPAA BAA explicitly listed as available on Pro, Growth, and Enterprise plans. Pro and Growth require annual billing; no published month-to-month rate. monthlyUsd reflects the published annual-equivalent monthly rate.

plans.name: Free Forever
plans.notes: Up to 7,500 MAUs. No overages — upgrade required to exceed limits. Includes core authentication methods.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Starts at $249/mo billed annually. 10,000 MAUs included. HIPAA BAA available. Month-to-month rate not published.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Starts at $799/mo billed annually. 25,000 MAUs included. HIPAA BAA available. FedRAMP High deployments available at extra cost. Month-to-month rate not published.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Custom MAU limits, tiered discounts, premium support add-on, dedicated CS engineer, HIPAA BAA. Everything in Growth.
